text: Watch two clear liquids turn black in the blink of an eye.
This is the iodine clock and the wait is the whole trick.
When the two liquids mix a slow reaction starts making iodine.
But a second chemical wipes the iodine out as fast as it forms.
So for a few seconds the mix stays perfectly clear.
It's a race and the eraser is winning.
Now the iodine stays and finds the starch we added.
Starch is a long coil and iodine slides inside it like beads on a string.
That coil soaks up almost every color of light.
So the whole flask turns black all at once.
Add more eraser and the clock waits longer. Watch it again.
